Jim Jones Archival Footage: Jim & The Jonestown Community
episodes.description:
Rare archival "Just Jim" footage and audio compilation sourced from Jonestown home videos. Released today for the 48th anniversary. While these archival uploads usually focus strictly on Jim Jones, given that it is November 18th—the date of the awful tragedy (Rest Easy, Beautiful Souls 💖)—this upload focuses not just on Jim, but on his interactions with the Peoples Temple community as a whole that he and everyone worked to build together.

The people who made it what it was. The people who fought and loved. Those who held Jim dear, and those he held dear. They are all important, and they all matter.

Rights owned by the California Historical Society (CHS) Collection at Stanford.

--------
CHAPTERS
0:00 Hugs & Kisses
0:38 Jim observing entertainment
1:01 Jim giving out treats
3:16 Pavilion Entertainment
7:29 Jim interviews Mom & Pop Jackson
8:44 Jim interviews youngsters
9:05 Jim & Becky Beikman
9:21 Jim & Community members afternoon snack
10:21 Jim interviewing youngsters & workers
11:23 Jim & Farm Supervisor
11:26 Jim & Group conversing 
12:52 Jim watches Tom Grubbs teach
14:37 Jim watches exercises
14:47 Jim greeting & chatting with people on road
15:59 Power of Father's socialism
16:22 Jim & Group outside
16:42: Jim, Man and the U.S.
16:52 Jim & Others give their waves & Goodbyes

episodes.title: Jim Jones Sings: Socialist Hymns
episodes.description:
Jim Jones and the  Peoples Temple choir sing various hymns including "Let God Arise" and "Socialist Today".

Lyrics
-------
Jones: (Sings) (Hymn) Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God arise in the earth. Oh, now let

Jones: (Sings) Let Go

Jones: (Sings) Let God— and his enemies be scattered, Let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God arise in the earth. Oh, Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God, let God arise and his enemies be scattered, Let God arise in the earth, Oh—

Another male sings

Jones: ‘S all right— (sings) and his enemies be scattered

Jones: (Sings) Spirit of the consciousness, of the presence of God. He is the source of all (unintelligible word). He can and he will

Jones:(Sings) He can, and he will, and he actually does, Satisfy every good desire. Don’t you know the spirit of the consciousness, of the presence of God, is the soul (unintelligible phrase) (tape fades, then edit)

Jones: (Sings) I’m a Socialist today, (unintelligible word)— I’m a Socialist today, I’m a Socialist all the way—

Man: (Sings) I’m a Socialist today, and I’m glad (fades). I’m a Socialist today, and I’m glad. I’m a Socialist today, and I’m glad. (tape edit) (Singing and trumpet)

Jones: (Singing) What a socialist father we have, what a socialist father we have, well, we were out in this world when our father brought us in, what a socialist father we have. What a socialist father we have. I said, what a socialist father we have, what a socialist father we have, we were out in this world when our father brought us in, what a socialist father we have. What a socialist father we have

Jones: (sings) by and by, when the morning comes, when all the saints of God are gathered home
(Sings) Amazing Grace, when we’ve been there 10,000 years, we’ll have no less days to sing God’s praise.
